instrument: Regulation (EU) 2023/1781 establishing a framework of measures for strengthening Europe's semiconductor ecosystem (Chips Act)
note: 41 Articles and 4 Annexes — verified against the EUR-Lex DOM on 2026-08-15. UNLIKE the other corpora this is the ORIGINAL act, not a consolidated text: EUR-Lex listed no consolidated version as at 2026-08-15 because the Chips Act has not been amended since adoption. 'consolidatedAs' is therefore the OJ publication date (OJ L 229, 18.9.2023) and the CELEX carries the 3-prefix of an original act rather than the 0-prefix of a consolidation. A first amendment will create a consolidated version at a new CELEX, which is what npm run reg:drift watches for. The source HTML contains 83 recitals under rct_ ids; the extractor walks only art_ and anx_ ids, so no recital reaches the corpus. Text is reused from EUR-Lex under CC BY 4.0 (Commission Decision 2011/833/EU).
